entities.summary: Aaron Dell is a Canadian former professional ice hockey goaltender. Originally undrafted, Dell has played seven seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL), mainly for the San Jose Sharks, and shorter stints for the New Jersey Devils and the Buffalo Sabres before retiring in 2025.
